Current carrier items/thm-conditional-monotone-convergence.md is published and homed at library/probability/conditional-expectation.md. Read its Statement and proof where present; actual excerpt: “Assume AC. For nonnegative measurable $X$ (possibly infinite), $E[X\mid\mathcal G]$ is the unique almost-sure class of nonnegative $\mathcal G$-measurable $Y$ satisfying $\int_A Y\,dP=\int_A X\,dP$ for every $A\in\mathcal G$. If $0\le X_n\uparrow X$ almost surely, then $E[X_n\mid\mathcal G]\uparrow E[X\mid\mathcal G]$ almost surely. Every increasing integrable nonnegative approximation to $X$ gives the same class. For integrable real $V_n\downarrow V$ almost surely with $V_0,V\in L^1$, $E[V_n\mid\mathcal G]\downarrow E[V\mid\mathcal G]$ almost surely.” Supplier use for this claim: passes the decreasing threshold events to the random-threshold event.
